name: Tangrowth
description: When it remains still, it appears to be a large shrub. Unsuspecting prey that wander near get ensnared by its vines.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.description: The foe is attacked with long, creeping tentacles or vines. It may also lower the target’s Speed.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.description: The user lays roots that restore HP on every turn. Because it is rooted, it can’t switch out.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep- inducing dust around the foe.

moves.name: Absorb
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Growth
moves.description: The user’s body is forced to grow all at once. It raises the Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Poison Powder
moves.description: A cloud of poisonous dust is scattered on the foe. It may poison the target.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.description: The foe is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Bind
moves.description: A long body or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the foe for two to five turns.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Stun Spore
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of paralyzing powder. It may paralyze the target.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a long tail, vines, etc., to inflict damage.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: The user tickles the foe into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Wring Out
moves.description: The user powerfully wrings the foe. The more HP the foe has, the greater this attack’s power.

moves.name: Power Whip
moves.description: The user violently whirls its vines or tentacles to harshly lash the foe.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.description: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. It sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.description: The foe is cut with a scythe or a claw. It can also be used to cut down thin trees.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Solar Beam
moves.description: A two-turn attack. The user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the second turn.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.description: A wondrous wall of light is put up to suppress damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Flash
moves.description: The user flashes a light that cuts the foe’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.description: The user attacks by hurling filthy sludge at the foe. It may also poison the target.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.description: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.description: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user hits with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot in rapid succession.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Shock Wave
moves.description: The user strikes the foe with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack cannot be evaded.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the foe. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the foe with grass and trips it. The heavier the foe, the greater the damage.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user attacks with its head. It may make the foe flinch. To find Pokémon, hit trees.

moves.name: Snore
moves.description: An attack that can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the foe flinch.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.description: The user adds its HP to the foe’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the foe.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.description: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. It may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the foe’s held item, preventing the item from being used during the battle.

moves.name: Block
moves.description: The user blocks the foe’s way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

moves.name: Worry Seed
moves.description: A seed that causes worry is planted on the foe. It prevents sleep by making its ability Insomnia.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.
